execution_note: Four separately frozen empirical scopes completed under current user continuation; this graph annotation authorizes no followup.

mechanism.statement: A source-held center-trained rank<=64 output basis leaves large remote-token innovation error even with true coefficients; corrective retained nonlinear features give a stronger representation than a more complex linear coefficient predictor. A fixed affine base plus complete original group features can be folded into a genuinely narrower native nonlinear path.
mechanism.math_or_trace: Fixed orthogonal output basis splits ungated squared error exactly into tail and coefficient error. RRR uses the exact ridge penalized rank constraint, yet predicts similarly to PCA-ridge. For q=kappa*a+beta+r and selected output V, affine+V(r_S-m)+d equals Ahat*x+V*q_S+Bhat, with Ahat=W2 diag(kappa) W1-V diag(kappa_S) W1_S. Continuous equality is not native bitwise equivalence.

availability.observer_computation: No current full-W1 observer in the finite native folded application. Offline data fitting and FP32 matrix formation are real, separately accounted work.
